title: The Seeker's Dilemma: Realistic Formulation and Benchmarking for Hardware Trojan Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on hardware security and the technical challenge of detecting hardware Trojans, framing it as 'The Seeker's Dilemma' which is an extension of Hide&Seek on a graph. It does not contain any component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
